2126314656486621669.en_summary: Good news for $MELI, $NU & Brazil: Luiz Carlos Trabuco has been named Brazil’s next Finance Minister. He’s seen as the fiscally disciplined & market friendly pick. Most assume his appointment means Lula will let him run a sustainable program. Brazil’s fiscal outlook is a big question mark right now, so the signal is great news for that market.
2126314656486621669.zh_summary: 對 $MELI、$NU 及巴西的好消息：Luiz Carlos Trabuco 被任命為巴西下一任財政部長。他被視為財政紀律嚴明且市場友好的選擇。大多數人假設他的任命意味著Lula將讓他運行可持續的計劃。巴西的財政前景目前是一個大問號，因此這個信號對該市場是好消息。

ticker_notes.MELI: 巴西新財長市場友好，財政紀律

2126314109167677723.en_summary: There are large insider purchases, and then there’s Bluerock Private Real Estate Fund $BPRE, where insiders (mostly a director) have been buying massive amounts of stock almost daily. BPRE is selling older holdings to buy industrial, long-lease, and real estate loan investments. It’s trading at a massive >40% discount to NAV. We previously flagged this one on Saba taking a ~5% stake. Expect more.
